name: Reggie Watts
biography: Reginald Lucien Frank Roger Watts is an American comedian, actor, beatboxer and musician. His improvised musical sets are created using only his voice, a keyboard and a looping machine. Watts refers to himself as a disinformationist who aims to disorient his audience, often in a comedic fashion.
